description: CryptoAudit: Crypto AI helps people analyze cryptocurrency markets inside ChatGPT. Users can view live charts, check market summaries, compare coins, review technical indicators like RSI and MACD, see support and resistance levels, track market sentiment, spot unusual whale activity, and explore AI-based price outlooks. It is built for quick research and clearer decision-making with simple, practical crypto insights.
